result.topic_en: Heavily corrected draft of the definition of simply and n-fold connected surfaces by means of cross-cuts (Querschnitte), with a planned proof that the number of cuts needed is independent of their choice; the left margin holds unrelated mechanical calculations (an oscillation equation with sin v) and logarithm expressions.
